description.en: Overrides the current match BGM with the given track ID, continuing playback without the usual match-BGM reset. Undo it later with CMND_BTL_RETURN_BGM.
BGM track ID string (hashed via CRC32) to switch to.
True once the BGM override has been applied (a no-op if bgmId is empty or the match system isn't active); null if no bgmId argument was given.
